prompt: The same wide-angle doorbell view, a little later: Jenny has stepped out over the threshold onto the stone doorstep on the left of the frame, a thick stack of folded leaflets in one hand, her head tilted back and her eyes narrowed as she sizes Brandon up. Brandon is on the right of the frame, his body turning back towards her, brows lifted, mouth a little open. The lens bulges at its edges, the sky behind them is a flat bleached white, the colours are washed out and compressed, and the hallway behind Jenny is a murky dark. A pair of wet wellies stands against the wall by the door. Thanks.
